verdict.rationale: Jitsu documents an MCP server and a Management API, but they cover pipeline configuration (destinations, streams, connections, Functions) and inspecting Live Events. Nothing in the evidence shows an agent querying customer or profile data, or creating or activating audiences, through an API or MCP. The in-function warehouse API (ctx.getWarehouse) and Profile Builder are developer building blocks and adjacent features, not the end-to-end audience capability the story asks for.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent can query customer data and create or activate audiences end to end through documented APIs or MCP — no dashboard in the loop
